dataset.name: Sephora Product Reviews
dataset.selection_rule: rating <= 1; contains explicit adverse skin-reaction language; three distinct public records
dataset.privacy_transform: User nicknames, author IDs, photos, locations and social metadata were removed. Product and brand are represented only by the public product ID and generic category.

records.title: No Improvements - Destroyed Skin Barrier
records.review_excerpt: After 3 months, I have seen absolutely no improvements. My skin looked dry, dull, flaky, red and distressed, and I broke out. My skin barrier felt destroyed.

records.title: Unbalanced skin
records.review_excerpt: Repeated use caused extremely unbalanced skin, rebound oiliness and unprecedented breakouts. The breakouts were very inflamed and painful and took days to settle.

records.title: Try something else
records.review_excerpt: It literally burned my skin and it is now flaky and peeling.
